audit.help: Check the tags Sift wrote. Preview the file, then mark each tag right or wrong. A wrong tag is removed from the file.
audit.none: Nothing left to check. New files will appear here as Sift tags them.
audit.wrongTip: Remove this tag from the file
cli.demo.blocked: not available in demo mode (it would change your real system); run `sift demo off` first
cli.dirs.mount: {path} is a mount point (network or cloud drive); Sift never scans those
cli.dirs.root: refusing to scan the whole filesystem
cli.scan.already: a scan is already running ({done} of {budget} files)
cli.store.changed: the file changed since it was classified
cli.store.outsideRoots: this file is outside the scanned folders
cli.tags.builtin: {tag} is a built-in label: it has no description to edit. You can rename it or delete it.
cli.tags.exists: {new} already exists: use `sift tags merge {old} --to {new}` to combine them
cli.tags.nothingChanged: Nothing was changed. Re-run with --yes to go ahead.
cli.tags.same: the new name is the same as the old one
cli.val.descTooLong: the description is too long ({n} characters; the limit is {max})
cli.val.glob: an ignore pattern must be 1 to {max} characters
cli.val.patternNested: this pattern has a repeated group inside a repeated group, which can take forever on some text; simplify it
cli.val.tagNeedsLetter: a tag name needs at least one letter or digit
cli.val.tagTooLong: a tag name can be at most {max} characters
cli.val.tooLong: {what} is too long ({n} characters; the limit is {max})
cli.val.unit: {what} must be a number between 0 and 1
demo.strip: Demo: sample data. Nothing real is touched.
ideas.hint: Click a tag to add it to your vocabulary, × to dismiss it.
mode.suggest: suggests only; you accept each tag
msg.scanAlready: A scan was already running, so nothing new was started
msg.scanRunning: A scan is already running ({done} of {budget} files). It will finish on its own.
reason.filename: name only, so never tagged automatically
reason.secret: possible secret, never sent or tagged
review.emptyNew: Nothing scanned yet. Press S to scan, or set up folders under Settings.
review.errorDetail: {error} Open Settings to set up the classifier, or run `sift doctor`.
review.hiddenHide: Showing generic guesses too. Click to hide them.
review.hiddenShow: Hidden generic guesses (log, code, other...): {n}. Click to show.
review.hint: Click a tag to apply it. ✓ applies every suggestion, × dismisses the file.
review.keys: ↑ ↓ select  ·  Enter apply  ·  X dismiss  ·  S scan
review.notReachable: The classifier is not reachable. Open Settings to set up the classifier, or run `sift doctor`.
role.classifies: classifies files and scores your tags
scan.runningTip: A scan is running: {done} of {budget} files
set.apiKeyTip: Store the key in the system keyring (typed in a terminal, never shown)
set.autoOff: Off: Sift only suggests; you accept each tag.
set.autoOn: Confident results are written to the files.
set.demoDesc: Try Sift on sample files. Nothing real is read or changed.
set.folderPh: add a folder, e.g. ~/Documents, then Enter
set.ignorePh: ignore a name or path, e.g. node_modules or ~/Documents/private/*
set.neverScanned: Network and cloud drives, hidden folders and dependency folders are never scanned.
set.noClassifier: No classifier is set up yet.
set.remoteShort: Remote: {host}. File text is sent there.
set.runsLocal: Runs on {host} (this machine or your network)
set.runsRemote: Remote: file text is sent to {host}. API key: {key}
set.setupTip: Choose Open-Jev, TypeSafe, Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
tags.deleteBody: Files affected: {n}. The tag is removed from them; their other tags stay and no file is deleted. Sift will not add this tag again. Undo the file changes later with `sift untag`.
tags.descPh: what is this tag about? (one sentence)
tags.mergeBody: Files affected: {n}. Files carrying one of these tags get "{to}" instead (once, other tags stay). The merged tags are still recognised, but only "{to}" is written to files. Undo later with `sift untag`.
tags.renameBody: Files affected: {n}. Their tags are rewritten (other tags stay). Undo later with `sift untag`.
tags.similarHeader: Similar tags  ·  you decide what is merged
row.addDescPh: What does it mean? (so Sift can find more files like this)
row.addHint: Enter saves. Existing tags are suggested as you type. A new tag with a description is learned and looked for in other files.
tags.unmergeBody: Files that had {tag} before the merge get it back, and Sift writes {tag} on its own again. You can undo the file changes.
tags.mergeWhich: Merge these (tap to include or leave out)
tags.mergeKeep: Keep {tag} as the tag that stays
